visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy dark hair and a white knitted sweater appears in a head-and-shoulders close-up. She smiles warmly at the camera while holding a small, pink rectangular product case in her hands. The setting is a brightly lit, neutral indoor studio with soft, even illumination. White text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a macro close-up of her hands as she applies a pale pink cream to her forearm, then to her face using a metal spatula and a black cushion puff. She looks focused, dabbing the product gently onto her cheek and forehead. The background remains out of focus and neutral. (3) She returns to a medium close-up, holding a white tube of 'PONY EFFECT' product. She points specifically to her undereye area and nose, pointing out skin details while smiling. The lighting remains high-key and flattering. Yellow subtitles and white brand logos are visible throughout. (4) The woman is shown applying more cream to her neck area with long, sweeping hand motions. She looks up and to the side, checking her reflection in an unseen mirror while maintaining a cheerful expression. The white sweater provides a soft texture against her smooth skin. (5) She holds up a pink cushion compact and applies it to her face with a black puff. The camera captures her face from different eye-level angles as she demonstrates the product's coverage. Her skin appears glowing and dewy. (6) A split-screen comparison appears, showing a 'Before' state on top and 'After' on the bottom, highlighting the difference in skin tone and texture. (7) The video concludes with a fast-paced montage of the woman posing in various cute and professional manners with both products, smiling broadly and looking directly at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with upbeat acoustic guitar strumming accompanied by a steady, light percussion beat in a major key. A female voice with a friendly and energetic tone introduces the content with clear articulation. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers precisely as a new subtitle appears, marking a technical benefit of the product. The speaker's pitch variability is high, conveying excitement. (3) A soft 'pop' sound effect is heard during a quick visual jump cut. The narrator continues her fast-paced explanation in Traditional Chinese, maintaining high vocal arousal. (4) The subtle rustle of a plastic tube can be heard briefly as she handles the product. The background music remains constant in tempo and volume, providing a cheerful bed for the narration. (5) A distinct mechanical click sound occurs as the cushion compact is opened. The speaker's voice rises in pitch to emphasize a recommendation. The blend between voice and music is balanced. (6) A final melodic bell stinger plays during the comparison montage. The narrator delivers a high-valence sign-off, and the guitar BGM fades out with a clear finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product 1 Features -> Application Demo -> Before/After Result -> Product 2 Features -> CTA/Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional beauty review designed to endorse PONY EFFECT makeup products. It aims to demonstrate the efficacy of a sunscreen base and a cushion compact, particularly for users with dry skin, by showing real-time application and split-screen results to build consumer trust and desire.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of the brand name 'PONY EFFECT' in logos and text, detailed verbal description of the product benefits, and direct recommendation to the audience.
